notes.subject: יכחשו
notes.rationale: kima-bayɛlɛmabaga bɛ siga: 'u bɛ jiya di' (KJV), 'u bɛ fɔ-fɔli kɛ' (YLТ), 'u bɛ bɔ nɔgɔya la' (JPS) — kɔrɔ tiɲɛ ye ko u bɛ fɔ ko u bɛ bolo di, nka u tɛ a tiɲɛ fɔ

notes.subject: נורא
notes.rationale: daɲɛ in bɛ sɔrɔ 'siran' (יָרֵא) fɛ — 'i baaraw bɛ mɔgɔw siran' kɔrɔ bɛ a la, siran ni tiɲɛ-dɔnni fila bɛ daɲɛ kelen kɔnɔ

notes.subject: aw b'a fɔ
notes.rationale: kɔrɔdɔnba kelen min bɛ wele aw fɛ ka kuma Elohim ye

translation: Aw b'a fɔ Elohim ye: i baaraw tiɲɛ na siranbaliya de ye! I seba bɛɛ la, i kinibaga bɛɛ bɛna i fɔ ko i ye ɲɛmɔgɔ ye, nka o tɛ a tiɲɛ ye.

tokens.gloss: bɛna i fɔ ko... o tɛ a tiɲɛ ye
